summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk, disclosing media coverage that the Deputy Minister of Immigration and Corrections, who also serves as a company commissioner, has been named a suspect in a corruption investigation. The filing states that the matter is unrelated to the commissioner's duties at the company and has no material impact on operations. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. This is a routine material information disclosure required by Indonesian regulations, with no US-equivalent special situation. The filing does not meet any special-situation category.
